title: Counterexamples to flagged LLT and nonsymmetric Macdonald atom positivity

definitions.name: x2611_16899_alpha
definitions.notes: The composition α in Theorem 1. Fin indices 0,…,13 correspond to paper indices 1,…,14.

definitions.name: x2611_16899_key_family
definitions.lean:
def x2611_16899_key_family (n : ℕ)
    (K : (Fin n → ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ)) : Prop :=
  (∀ b, Antitone b → K b = Finset.univ.prod (fun i => MvPolynomial.X i ^ b i)) ∧
  ∀ (b : Fin n → ℕ) (i j : Fin n), j.val = i.val + 1 → b i < b j →
    (MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.X j) * K b =
      MvPolynomial.X i * K (b ∘ Equiv.swap i j) -
      MvPolynomial.X j * MvPolynomial.rename (Equiv.swap i j) (K (b ∘ Equiv.swap i j))
definitions.notes: A predicate specifying the key polynomials from their exact initial condition and adjacent-ascent recursion. The divided-difference equation is multiplied by x_i−x_{i+1}, so it is expressed entirely in Mathlib multivariate polynomials. This does not assert the theorem being audited.

definitions.name: x2611_16899_atom_family
definitions.lean:
def x2611_16899_atom_family (n : ℕ) (τ : RatFunc ℚ)
    (A : (Fin n → ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ)) : Prop :=
  (∀ b, Antitone b → A b = Finset.univ.prod (fun i => MvPolynomial.X i ^ b i)) ∧
  ∀ (b : Fin n → ℕ) (i j : Fin n), j.val = i.val + 1 → b i < b j →
    (MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.X j) * A b =
      MvPolynomial.C (1 - τ) * MvPolynomial.X j *
        (A (b ∘ Equiv.swap i j) - MvPolynomial.rename (Equiv.swap i j) (A (b ∘ Equiv.swap i j))) +
      MvPolynomial.C τ * (MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.X j) *
        MvPolynomial.rename (Equiv.swap i j) (A (b ∘ Equiv.swap i j))
definitions.notes: A predicate specifying the atom family with parameter τ. Clearing the denominator in T_i=(1−τ)(π_i−1)+τs_i gives (1−τ)x_{i+1}(f−s_i f)+τ(x_i−x_{i+1})s_i f. Use τ=RatFunc.X for t-atoms and τ=0 for ordinary atoms. The initial condition is exactly the printed one.

definitions.name: x2611_16899_expansion
definitions.lean:
def x2611_16899_expansion (n d : ℕ)
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ))
    (A : (Fin n → ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ))
    (c : (Fin n → ℕ) → RatFunc ℚ) : Prop :=
  P = Finset.univ.sum (fun γ : Fin n → Fin (d + 1) =>
    if Finset.univ.sum (fun i : Fin n => (γ i).val) = d then
      MvPolynomial.C (c (fun i => (γ i).val)) * A (fun i => (γ i).val) else 0)
definitions.notes: The homogeneous degree-d basis-expansion relation, with coefficients in ℚ(t). Enumerate all degree-d weak compositions using functions Fin n→Fin(d+1), and retain those of sum d. Entries outside degree d are irrelevant. This specifies coefficients without postulating a new basis theorem or presuming the claimed numeric values.

definitions.name: x2611_16899_counterexample_polynomial
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_16899_counterexample_polynomial : Polynomial ℚ :=
  Polynomial.X^5 + Polynomial.X^6 + 2*Polynomial.X^7 - Polynomial.X^10 +
  5*Polynomial.X^11 + 10*Polynomial.X^12 + 26*Polynomial.X^13 + 42*Polynomial.X^14 +
  58*Polynomial.X^15 + 66*Polynomial.X^16 + 59*Polynomial.X^17 + 42*Polynomial.X^18 +
  22*Polynomial.X^19 + 7*Polynomial.X^20 + Polynomial.X^21
definitions.notes: The explicit polynomial printed in equation (2), recorded independently of the actual expansion coefficient. Equality to that coefficient is a worklist claim, not part of this definition.

definitions.name: x2611_16899_prefix_height
definitions.lean:
def x2611_16899_prefix_height {n : ℕ} (b : Fin n → ℕ) (k : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  (k : ℤ) - Finset.univ.sum (fun i : Fin n => if i.val < k then (b i : ℤ) else 0)
definitions.notes: h_k=k−Σ_{j=1}^k b_j, using integers so a negative height remains negative.

definitions.name: x2611_16899_flagged_llt
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_16899_flagged_llt (n : ℕ) : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ) :=
  Finset.univ.sum (fun w : Fin n → Fin n =>
    if ∀ j : Fin n, (w j).val < n - j.val then
      MvPolynomial.C (RatFunc.X ^
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)).filter
          (fun ij => ij.1 < ij.2 ∧ w ij.2 < w ij.1)).card) *
      Finset.univ.prod (fun j : Fin n => MvPolynomial.X (w j)) else 0)
definitions.notes: The exact finite word sum defining G_n in Section 2. A Lean value w_j∈Fin n represents the paper entry w_j+1; the flag condition is w_j.val<n−j.val, and the inversion statistic compares values. The product places one x_{w_j} for each position. Coefficients are rational functions in t.

statements.label: Theorem 1 (minimality family)
statements.name: x2611_16899_thm1_minimality
statements.original:
Moreover, for every $n\leq 13$ and every
 $b\in\{0,1,2\}^{n}$ with $|b|=n$ , the coefficient
 $c_{b,(1^{n})}(t)$ has no negative terms. Thus degree fourteen is minimal
within this family.

statements.notes: Includes n=0 because the paper prints every n≤13 without a positive lower bound. b_i≤2 with b_i natural is b∈{0,1,2}ⁿ. Together with the degree-14 negative coefficient this expresses the stated minimality within the indicated family, without claiming global minimality over all weak compositions.

fidelity.equivalence_proof:
theorem x2611_16899_thm1_minimality_eqv :
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ 13) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (hb : ∀ i, b i ≤ 2)
      (hs : Finset.univ.sum b = n)
      (K A : (Fin n → ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ))
      (c : (Fin n → ℕ) → RatFunc ℚ)
      (hK : x2611_16899_key_family n K)
      (hA : x2611_16899_atom_family n RatFunc.X A)
      (hc : x2611_16899_expansion n n (K b) A c),
      (c (fun _ => 1)).denom = 1 ∧
        ∀ r : ℕ, 0 ≤ (c (fun _ => 1)).num.coeff r) ↔
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ 13) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (hb : ∀ i, b i ≤ 2)
      (hsize : ∑ i, b i = n)
      (K A : (Fin n → ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ))
      (hK : x2611_16899_key_family n K)
      (hA : x2611_16899_atom_family n RatFunc.X A)
      (c : (Fin n → ℕ) → RatFunc ℚ)
      (hc : x2611_16899_expansion n n (K b) A c),
      ∃ p : Polynomial ℚ, (∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ p.coeff k) ∧
        algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) (RatFunc ℚ) p = c (fun _ => 1)) := by
  constructor
  · intro h n hn b hb hsize K A hK hA c hc
    obtain ⟨hd, hpos⟩ := h n hn b hb hsize K A c hK hA hc
    refine ⟨(c (fun _ => 1)).num, hpos, ?_⟩
    simpa only [hd, map_one, div_one] using RatFunc.num_div_denom (c (fun _ => 1))
  · intro h n hn b hb hs K A c hK hA hc
    obtain ⟨p, hpos, hp⟩ := h n hn b hb hs K A hK hA c hc
    rw [← hp, RatFunc.denom_algebraMap, RatFunc.num_algebraMap]
    exact ⟨rfl, hpos⟩

statements.label: After Theorem 1 (proper prefix heights)
statements.name: x2611_16899_alpha_prefix_heights
statements.original:
The proper prefix heights $h_{i}=i-\sum_{j=1}^{i}\alpha_{j}$ , for $1\leq i<14$ , are
 $h=(1,(2,2,1)^{4})$ . Thus negativity already occurs when all prefix heights
